nary_nodes.label: Bresnik on crew's unifying link
evidence: "We are certainly humbled as a crew," Bresnik told the crowd at the Johnson Space Center, "being that unifying link between the phenomenal Artemis II mission we just had two months ago and the Artemis IV mission that will follow ours, where we will again... land humans on another celestial body."

nary_nodes.label: Douglas on honor of serving
evidence: Douglas told CBS News, "To get an opportunity to serve in the Artemis program as someone who kind of just came in the door not too long ago, it's a huge honor."

nary_nodes.label: Rubio on returning to space
evidence: Speaking of returning to space after his record-setting trip, Rubio said it's "part of my job, ultimately, and it's something I love, and I'm blessed enough to have a supportive family who's willing to try it again."
He also called it an honor and privilege.

nary_nodes.label: Parmitano on family sacrifice
evidence: Added Parmitano: "My personal take, we as astronauts, we don't make any sacrifices.
We do what we love and love what we do.
Our families, though, they make the sacrifice every time we go away for a trip.
Every time we break their hearts for two weeks, for 371 days, for six months.
I have learned to embrace that hurt, because it reminds me that I still have the right values in my heart."

nary_nodes.label: Artemis III flight as major test
evidence: The flight will pose a major test for mission managers and engineers with NASA, SpaceX and Blue Origin, who will have to launch multiple heavy-lift rockets in a matter of days and then coordinate their flights in a multi-vehicle sequence of tightly scripted maneuvers.

nary_nodes.label: Parsons on choreographed operations
evidence: "This test flight will enable us to prove we can carry out highly choreographed operations with our (commercial) partners across hardware interfaces, software, propulsion systems and life support elements with crew in the high stakes space environment," said Jeremy Parsons, a senior manager in NASA's "Moon to Mars" program office.

nary_nodes.label: Parsons on refining plans for Artemis IV
evidence: He said "every aspect" of the Artemis III mission "will give us insight into how to refine our plans for Artemis IV and beyond, and buy down risk."

nary_nodes.label: Bresnik on launch complexity
evidence: "Sometimes those [launches] don't go exactly when we plan on it," Bresnik told CBS News.
... "So that's multiple launch campaigns.

This is all stuff that we need to figure out if we're going to be able to do the more complex rendezvousing everybody in lunar orbit."
